suggested_change: Clarify: (1) When call summary fails, explicitly allow re-scoring with reduced confidence rather than contradicting carry-forward logic. (2) Define 'concrete action verbs'—provide whitelist (Ask, Probe, Determine, Clarify) vs. blacklist (Validate, Confirm) with context. (3) Separate 'evidence from transcript' from 'evidence from carry-forward'—allow paraphrase-only carry-forward if source calls exist and are documented, but flag confidence downgrade.
